name: discover-layer-units-full
description: The `units` layer's descriptor at `form: "full"` — the one form that carries the descriptor PROSE, asked for one layer at a time because the project-wide `full` discovery is REFUSED with `over-budget` on every project (`negative/discover-project-full-over-budget.json`), and the refusal's second step is exactly this request. Together the fifteen per-layer `full` vectors replay every layer, kind and field annotation the model contract ships, verbatim, which is where the shipped-prose oracle (`packages/tools/tests/test_model_contract_conformance.py`) rides: rewording an annotation in the contract is a protocol-output change, and this is the output it changes. Of this layer: the `units` layer contract `8.0.0` added for the unit a type names by reference, stored one directory below `data_types/` in `data_types/units/`, with exactly one kind, `unit`, and therefore no discriminator. An application type's `unit_ref` and a linear compu method's `unit` are resolved in this layer alone.

context.summary: The `examples/basic` shape of a SWCraft project: fifteen scaffolded layers, `units` among them and empty in `data_types/units/`. Nothing about the response depends on which elements are in the layer: the inventory is derived from the model contract through the registry, not from the files.

layers.description: Units, one file each under `data_types/units/`: the unit a physical value is measured in, an element a type names by reference. One kind, `unit`, which an application type names as its `unit_ref` and a `linear` compu method as its `unit`. The directory is mandatory and may be empty.

element_kinds.description: A unit, emitted as a `UNIT` in `/DataTypes/Units`: the name a type's physical value is measured in and the text it is shown as. An application type names one by its `unit_ref`, in place of the inline `unit` text, and a `linear` compu method by its `unit`. A unit's SI relation and physical dimension are not held, so every unit has the defaults the standard gives them.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The unit's identity; the file is named from it (`data_types/units/{name}.yaml`, or a suffixed name when another file collides case-insensitively) and is never what identifies it. Unique across the units, must not be blank, and immutable; an element of another layer may carry the same name.

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: The text the unit is shown as (for example `km/h`), written as the `UNIT`'s `DISPLAY-NAME` exactly as held; the empty default writes none.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Free text about the unit. Written into the generated ARXML as the element's `DESC`, exactly as held; the empty default writes none.

fields.name: package
fields.description: The one sub-package of `/DataTypes/Units`, its layer's package, this unit is emitted in, a single SHORT-NAME segment: the unit and every reference to it take `/DataTypes/Units/{package}/`. Absent means `/DataTypes/Units` itself. It is held to the AUTOSAR Identifier rule.

expected.notes: The same document the default form answers with `description` restored on the layer, on every kind and on every field that declares one, and with the three descriptor booleans spelled out where the default form omits them at `false` — `optional` on the layer, `required` and `immutable` on every field. Nothing else is restored, because nothing else is left out. `baseline` is the stand-in token every vector carries; a harness replaces it with the project's own.
